jobs.occupation: Tractor and Farm Machinery Operator
jobs.description:
Holsfjord Produkter DA is looking for an experienced and reliable tractor driver for the 2027 season.

We are a vegetable farm in Sylling, Lier, approximately 40 km west of Oslo. We grow iceberg lettuce, Chinese cabbage, cauliflower, and kale.

The job

Your main tasks will be tractor and machinery operation, including soil preparation, planting, and cultivation. Other duties include:

· Moving and handling irrigation equipment

· Daily checks and basic maintenance of machinery

· Transporting vegetables from the fields to cooling and storage facilities

· Loading and unloading produce and equipment

· Helping with planting, harvesting, and other physical farm work when needed

What we are looking for

· Experience operating tractors and agricultural machinery

· A valid driving licence: category T, C, or BE

· Ability to speak and understand English

· Someone who works independently, takes care of equipment, and is willing to help with different tasks

What we offer

· Seasonal employment from April to September 2027

· NOK 190--215 per hour before tax, depending on experience and qualifications

· Guaranteed 40 hours per week, with an expected average of around 45 hours depending on the season, weather, and workload

· Employment conditions in accordance with Norwegian labour laws, including overtime compensation, holiday pay, pension, and employee insurance

· Accommodation available on the farm with a private room; rental price to be confirmed

· A friendly and supportive working environment

· Opportunity to return for future seasons --- we hope to find someone who will work with us for many years

How to apply

Send a short introduction and a few details about your experience to holsfjordprodukterda@gmail.com. Please include which tractors and implements you have used and when you are available to work.

Please include a reference from a previous employer, if available. You are welcome to attach a CV.

Application deadline: 1 December 2026

For questions, contact:

John Rasmus Swang | Farm Manager

holsfjordprodukterda@gmail.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Holsfjord Produkter DA is a vegetable farm in Sylling, Lier, approximately 40 km west of Oslo, Norway. We grow iceberg lettuce, Chinese cabbage, cauliflower, and kale. We focus on quality, efficient production, and a friendly working environment, and value long-term relationships with our seasonal employees.

jobs.description:
WE ARE HIRING GUIDES FOR SEASON 2027 who would like to be based in Voss/nearby areas! 

Are you passionate about Norway’s stunning fjords, rich culture, and vibrant landscapes? Nordic Gateway is seeking enthusiastic German speakers to join our team for the Spring and Summer season. Lead tours through the breathtaking regions of Eidfjord, Flåm,and Vik, and make every journey an unforgettable experience for travelers from around the world!

• Season starts in February all the way to December.

Who We’re Looking For:

• Language: GERMAN and ENGLISH 
• Based already in Voss or nearby areas. If you’re not currently based here, we can assist in finding accommodation.
• Friendly, approachable personality: Prior customer service experience is an asset, as we’re looking for guides who will like to make our guests feel welcomed
• Passion for Norwegian nature, culture, and history: Whether you’re well-versed or just passionate, we value enthusiasm and dedication to sharing Norway’s wonders.
• Flexible and adaptable: Willing to travel on short notice and take on varied assignments in different locations.
• Reliable and trustworthy: Honesty and reliability are core values for our team.

Why Join Nordic Gateway?

• Highly Competitive wages
• Varied assignments across multiple stunning locations, including Eidfjord, Flåm, Vik.
• Future career opportunities: Continue as a guide in other seasons or explore the potential to work in other Norwegian ports.

Application Details

• Start with Your Language Skills: Please list your language proficiency at the beginning of your application. 
• Highlight your previous job experience related to tourisim/guiding.

Don’t miss this opportunity to spend your summer sharing Norway’s majestic fjords and vibrant culture with travelers from around the world. Join us for an adventure of a lifetime with Nordic Gateway!

jobs.occupation: Bussjåfør
jobs.description:
Yrkessjåfører søkes – buss, minibuss, lastebil og vogntog

Professional Drivers Wanted – Bus, Minibus, Truck.

English text below the Norwegian text.

Arbeidssted: Finnsnes, Troms

Ulf Trulsen AS, Senja Tours og Finnsnes Termotransport søker dyktige og pålitelige yrkessjåfører til våre virksomheter på Finnsnes.

Vi søker

• Bussjåfører – klasse D til turbuss og persontransport

• Minibussjåfører – klasse D1

• Lastebilsjåfører – klasse C/CE til godstransport, distribusjon og langtransport

Fleksible turnusordninger

Vi tilbyr flere arbeidsordninger og ønsker å finne en løsning som passer den enkelte sjåfør:

• Fast heltidsstilling med ordinær arbeidstid

• 14/14-turnus – 14 dager arbeid / 14 dager fri

• Månedsturnus – én måned arbeid / én måned fri

• Andre turnusordninger etter avtale

Turnusordningene gjør stillingene godt egnet for deg som ønsker å pendle mellom hjemlandet og Norge, samtidig som du får lengre perioder fri.

Bolig og innkvartering

Vi kan hjelpe sjåfører som ønsker å flytte til Norge med å finne bolig i Finnsnesområdet.

For deg som ønsker å pendle, kan vi undersøke rimelige løsninger for innkvartering i arbeidsperiodene, for eksempel:

• Hybel

• Leilighet

• Boligmodul

• Annen egnet innkvartering

Vi ønsker å gjøre det enkelt å kombinere arbeid hos oss med bosted og familieliv i hjemlandet.

Vi hjelper deg med overgangen til Norge

For kandidater fra Norden og EU/EØS kan vi bistå med praktiske spørsmål knyttet til oppstart i Norge, blant annet:

• Førerkort og YSK

• Norske krav og regler

• Skatteregistrering

• Bolig og innkvartering

• Andre praktiske og administrative forhold

Vi vurderer hver kandidat individuelt og forsøker å finne gode løsninger for både arbeid, turnus, bolig og pendling.

Om Finnsnes

Finnsnes ligger i Senja kommune i Troms i Nord-Norge og er et viktig transport- og regionsenter i Midt-Troms. Området byr på spektakulær nordnorsk natur, samtidig som Finnsnes har et aktivt næringsliv og gode servicetilbud.

Vi ser etter deg som

• Har førerkort D, D1, C eller CE, avhengig av stillingen

• Har nødvendig YSK

• Er en trygg og ansvarsfull sjåfør

• Er serviceinnstilt og profesjonell

• Kan arbeide selvstendig og fleksibelt

• Behersker norsk, svensk, dansk, finsk eller engelsk

Erfaring som yrkessjåfør er en fordel.

Interessert?

Send oss gjerne CV og en kort presentasjon av deg selv. Oppgi hvilken førerkortklasse du har, hvilken type kjøring du er interessert i, og om du ønsker fast arbeid, turnus eller pendling.

Vi oppfordrer kvalifiserte sjåfører fra Norge, Norden og EU/EØS til å søke.

Arbeidssted: Finnsnes, Troms

Stillinger: D / D1 / C / CE

Arbeidsform: Fast stilling og ulike turnusordninger

Oppstart: Etter avtale

In ENGLISH:

Professional Drivers Wanted – Bus, Minibus, Truck.

Location: Finnsnes, Troms, Northern Norway

Ulf Trulsen AS, Senja Tours and Finnsnes Termotransport are looking for skilled and reliable professional drivers to join our operations in Finnsnes.

We are looking for

• Bus drivers – Category D for coach/tour bus and passenger transport

• Minibus drivers – Category D1

• Truck drivers – Category C/CE for freight transport, distribution and long-haul transport

Flexible shift and rotation schedules

We offer several work arrangements and aim to find a solution that suits each individual driver:

• Full-time positions with regular working hours

• 14/14 rotation – 14 days working / 14 days off

• Monthly rotation – one month working / one month off

• Other rotation schedules by agreement

Our rotation schedules are particularly suitable for drivers who wish to commute between their home country and Norway, while enjoying longer periods of time off.

Accommodation and housing

We can assist drivers who wish to relocate to Norway in finding accommodation in the Finnsnes area.

For drivers who prefer to commute, we can also look into affordable accommodation during working periods, such as:

• Rooms

• Apartments

• Modular accommodation

• Other suitable housing solutions

Our goal is to make it as easy as possible to combine working with us with living and family life in your home country.

We help you with the transition to Norway

For candidates from the Nordic countries and EU/EEA, we can provide guidance and practical assistance with matters related to starting work in Norway, including:

• Driving licences and Driver CPC / YSK

• Norwegian rules and requirements

• Tax registration

• Housing and accommodation

• Other practical and administrative matters

We assess each candidate individually and aim to find good solutions regarding work arrangements, rotation schedules, accommodation and commuting.

About Finnsnes

Finnsnes is located in Senja Municipality in Troms, Northern Norway, and is an important transport and regional centre in Mid-Troms. The area offers spectacular Northern Norwegian nature, while Finnsnes has an active business community and good local services.

We are looking for someone who

• Holds a Category D, D1, C or CE driving licence, depending on the position

• Holds the required Driver CPC / YSK

• Is a safe and responsible driver

• Is service-minded and professional

• Works well independently and is flexible

• Speaks Norwegian (or another Scandinavian langiage) and/or English

Previous professional driving experience is an advantage.

Interested?

Please send us your CV and a short introduction about yourself. Let us know which driving license category you hold, what type of driving you are interested in, and whether you are looking for a full-time position, rotation work or a commuting arrangement.

We welcome qualified drivers from Norway, the Nordic countries and the EU/EEA to apply.

Location: Finnsnes, Troms, Norway

Positions: D / D1 / C / CE

Work arrangements: Full-time and various rotation schedules

Start date: By agreement

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ulf Trulsen AS, Senja Tours og Finnsnes Termotransport søker dyktige og pålitelige yrkessjåfører til våre virksomheter på Finnsnes.

jobs.occupation: Electricians (Group L) / Traveling Electricians (with DSB) – Data Center Project
jobs.description:
Electricians (Group L) / Traveling Electricians Wanted for an Exciting Data Center Project – 14/14 Rotation!
Would you like to be part of building a new, modern data center in Norway?

 

We are looking for skilled and qualified electricians to join an exciting, long-term project offering competitive salaries, an attractive 14/14 rotation schedule, and free accommodation!

 

On behalf of our client, a well-established and growing company, we are recruiting qualified electricians and traveling electricians for a major data center construction project.

This is an excellent opportunity to become part of a large-scale, technically challenging construction project that is expected to continue for several years.

 

You will have the opportunity to develop your professional skills, work with modern electrical installations, and contribute to the development of essential infrastructure for the future.

The position is project-based but offers long-term prospects and excellent opportunities for continuous employment over several years.
What We Offer
• 14/14 rotation schedule – 14 days of work followed by 14 consecutive days off.
• Competitive salary and attractive financial conditions.
• Free accommodation – accommodation costs are covered by the employer during working periods.
• Opportunity to participate in the construction of a new, modern data center.
• Long-term project expected to last several years.
• Varied and technically challenging tasks.
• Excellent opportunities for professional development and valuable project experience.
• Pension and insurance benefits.
• A professional, international, and inclusive working environment with experienced colleagues.Main Responsibilities
• Perform electrical installations as part of the construction of a new data center.
• Install and assemble electrical systems and technical equipment.
• Carry out cable pulling, electrical connections, and other electrical installation work.
• Cooperate with other trades and professionals on a large-scale construction project.
• Ensure that all work complies with applicable regulations, quality requirements, and Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) standards.Qualifications
• Norwegian Electrician Trade Certificate (Group L) or valid DSB approval.
• Valid FSE certification.
• Experience with electrical installations, preferably from large industrial or construction projects.
• Valid Category B driving licence.
• Norwegian or English
• Flexibility and motivation to work on a 14/14 rotation schedule.Personal Qualities
• Responsible, reliable, and punctual.
• Independent, well-organized, and solution-oriented.
• Quality-conscious with a strong focus on workplace safety and HSE.
• Good teamwork and communication skills.
• Positive attitude and motivation to contribute to a long-term project.Interested? Apply Today!
This is a fantastic opportunity for electricians looking for competitive pay, an attractive rotation schedule, and the chance to participate in a major data center construction project lasting several years.

 

You will gain valuable experience working on a modern technology infrastructure project while enjoying 14 consecutive days off between working periods.

 

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible!

Please send your CV and application to jelizaveta@job4u.no, using the subject line "Electrician – Data Center".
Contact Information
Jelizaveta JefimenkoJob4u.no AS

Phone: +47 468 80 060Email: jelizaveta@job4u.no

jobs.description: Would you like to combine a meaningful job with proximity to stunning nature?We are recruiting registered nurses for permanent full-time positions within municipal healthcare services in Western Norway.The positions are connected to nursing homes and home-based care services, where you will have the opportunity to work closely with patients and contribute to safe, high-quality healthcare services.The workplace is beautifully located between fjords, high mountains and spectacular scenery. The area offers excellent opportunities for outdoor activities throughout the year, while still providing easy access to a larger town within approximately 40 minutes by car.Here, you will find a working environment that offers responsibility, professional challenges and good opportunities to develop your experience within municipal healthcare. Feel free to reach out for more information. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: We seek nurses for permanent positions in Snåsa in Norway
jobs.description: Would you like a permanent nursing position with varied responsibilities and nature right outside your door?On behalf of Snåsa Municipality in Trøndelag, Norway, we are seeking three registered nurses for permanent positions within the municipal healthcare and care services.Here, you will enjoy a varied and meaningful workday, providing care and follow-up for patients both in home care services and in institutional settings. You will become part of a professional healthcare environment where nurses play a key role, with a high degree of autonomy, varied clinical responsibilities, and close collaboration with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.At the same time, you will have the opportunity to live in a place where nature is never far away. Snåsa is located next to the Blåfjella-Skjækerfjella National Park, offering vast forests, mountains, and excellent opportunities for hiking, cycling, hunting, and fishing. With a population of approximately 2,100 people, Snåsa is also a welcoming community where it is easy to get to know people and feel at home.About the positionAs a Registered Nurse, you will have a varied workday caring for patients with different needs in both home care services and institutional care settings.Typical responsibilities include:    Providing daily nursing care and professional follow-up to patients in home care services and/or institutional care    Observing, assessing, and documenting patients’ health conditions    Medication administration and treatment in accordance with applicable guidelines and regulations    Collaborating with other healthcare professionals, family members, and multidisciplinary teams    Contributing to quality improvement initiatives and the development of local routines and patient care pathwaysThe position involves shift work, including day, evening, and weekend shifts. You will have a significant level of professional responsibility and will work both independently and closely with other professional groups. High-quality, safe patient care is at the heart of everything, while maintaining a positive working environment built on collaboration, well-being, and good humor.QualificationsWe are looking for someone who is professionally engaged, responsible, and enjoys working both independently and as part of a team.    Authorization as a registered nurse in an EU or EEA country    Good communication skills in English and willingness to learn Norwegian    Valid police clearance and health certificate including tuberculosis and MRSA before starting    Valid driver’s licence (Class B)    Professionally engaged and responsible    Strong teamwork and adaptability skills    Experience from elderly care, home care services, or rehabilitation is an advantageWe offer    Permanent employment with competitive terms and conditions    Free Norwegian language training provided    A stable and predictable working environment    Varied and meaningful nursing responsibilities    A supportive and collaborative team environment, including guidance when needed    Excellent opportunities for professional development and continuing education    Attractive municipal pension and insurance schemes through KLP    Additional compensation for evening, night, and weekend work    Support and follow-up from Dignus Medical throughout the application and employment process    Support with housing and relocation when neededLife in SnåsaSnåsa is located in the northern part of Trøndelag, along the E6 highway and the Nordland Railway, approximately 50 minutes from Steinkjer. The municipality has around 2,100 residents and is ideal for those who wish to live close to nature while being part of a small and welcoming community. The area offers an active sports and cultural scene, shops, cafés, and excellent opportunities for outdoor activities all year round.For those relocating with family, the municipality offers good capacity in kindergartens, schools, and after-school programs, as well as a variety of leisure activities for children and families. Trondheim Airport Værnes is approximately two hours away by car, and the Nordland Railway also provides convenient transportation to and from Snåsa.Interested?Feel free to contact us for more information or submit a short application today!

jobs.occupation: Looking for a long-term nursing opportunity in Østfold?
jobs.description: We are recruiting registered nurses for permanent full-time positions in the Østfold region in southeastern Norway, on behalf of several municipalities.Østfold is a welcoming region in southeastern Norway, known for its beautiful coastline, scenic landscapes and close proximity to Oslo and Sweden. jobs.occupation: Head Chef Wanted for Nystua Skeikampen
jobs.description:
Would you like to lead the kitchen at one of Norway’s most beautiful mountain destinations?
Nystua Skeikampen is looking for an enthusiastic and hands-on Head Chef for the 2026–2027 winter season, with a start date of 1 December 2026.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about great food, enjoys leading people, and is motivated by creating memorable experiences for both guests and colleagues. With us, you will have the opportunity to combine active kitchen operations with leadership in an environment defined by quality, genuine hospitality, and outstanding guest experiences.

Nystua is a natural gathering place in Skeikampen, welcoming cabin owners, skiers, local residents, groups, and events throughout the winter season.
Your responsibilities
• 
Daily leadership and operational management of the kitchen

• 
Personnel responsibility for the kitchen team

• 
Staff scheduling and workforce planning

• 
Ordering, receiving, and managing stock and inventory

• 
Ensuring strong routines for food safety, health & safety, and internal control procedures

• 
Actively working to reduce food waste

• 
Managing supplier relationships

• 
Planning and executing events, functions, and group bookings

• 
Working closely with the General Manager and the rest of the management team
We are looking for someone who
• 
Has experience as a Head Chef or Sous Chef with leadership responsibilities

• 
Holds a culinary qualification or equivalent relevant experience

• 
Is a confident and inspiring leader

• 
Has a good understanding of efficient operations and quality management

• 
Has solid knowledge of food safety and professional kitchen operations

• 
Thrives in a fast-paced and varied working environment

• 
Is structured, solution-oriented, and quality focused

• 
Is motivated by developing people and building strong teams

• 
Communicates well in English or a Scandinavian language
What we offer
• 
A key leadership role in an exciting mountain destination

• 
Significant influence on the development of the kitchen operation

• 
A strong professional environment within food, beverage, and restaurant operations

• 
Close collaboration with experienced leaders and Head Chefs within Resthon

• 
Excellent development and career opportunities within Resthon and Thon Group

• 
Competitive employment terms

• 
Access to relevant employee benefits and discount schemes within Thon Group, subject to applicable policies

• 
Assistance in finding accommodation for the right candidate

• 
A varied and social working environment throughout the season
About us
Nystua Skeikampen is operated by Resthon AS, the restaurant and hospitality division of Thon Group.

Resthon operates restaurants, pubs, and hospitality concepts with a focus on quality, great products, and memorable guest experiences. As part of Thon Group, you will become part of a large professional network with strong development opportunities and a focus on internal career growth.

Thon Group is one of Norway’s largest privately owned companies, with operations in hotels, real estate, and food & beverage. Through Thon Hotels, Resthon, and its other businesses, the group offers exciting career opportunities in a workplace built on trust, engagement, creativity, and long-term development.

There may be opportunities for continued employment after the winter season.
Ready for a winter in the mountains?
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. If you would like more information about the position or life in Skeikampen during the winter season, please feel free to contact us.

Join us and help create the best guest experiences of the winter season at Nystua Skeikampen. We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.description:

Reine Rorbuer is looking for a certified kayak guide for a 50% position during the busiest part of the summer season.

What we offer:

• 

Work in the heart of Reine

• 

Spend your working days outdoors on the fjord

• 

Meet guests from all over the world

• 

Join a small, friendly and supportive team

• 

Possibility to work more than 50% by combining kayak guiding with shifts in other departments, depending on your experience and our operational needs

•

• 

is a certified kayak guide with sea kayaking experience

• 

has a full driving licence

• 

speaks fluent English

• 

is fit, reliable and comfortable working outdoors in changing weather

• 

is service-minded and good with people

• 

is available for the full period 15 June -- 15 August 2027

Hospitality experience, Scandinavian languages, photography are an advantage.

Send your CV and a short introduction to blaz@reinerorbuer.no, including information about your kayak qualifications and previous guiding experience.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Reine Rorbuer resort, our guided kayak tours, hikes, photo tours and Northern Lights tours help guests experience the extraordinary landscape of Lofoten. Based in the fishing village of Reine, where the mountains meet the Arctic Ocean, we aim to make every activity as memorable for its warm, attentive service as for its setting.

We hold our activities to a high standard, and our guided kayak tours have earned a high guest satisfaction score. We're looking for people who take pride in that standard and are committed to giving every activity guest an outstanding experience.
